Suggested windows next week (all PT):
- Tue 2026-03-09 10:00-12:00
- Wed 2026-03-10 13:00-16:00
- Thu 2026-03-11 09:00-12:00

Can you confirm which day/time works?

Internal notes: dev, steph - will need you for the hands-on (prompt tuning + routing walkthrough). Rachel, I’ve looped you for exec alignment if needed.

Agenda (attached draft): kickoff goals, internal roles, success criteria, hands-on topics (prompt sets, routing, caching, simple load test), next steps.
